title: BetterHitreg
description: Client-side hit feedback for Minecraft Bedrock.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turns the whole mod on or off.

hitreg.title: Hit prediction
hitreg.description: Show the hurt flash on the target before the server confirms the hit.

hurtFlash.title: Predict hurt flash
hurtFlash.description: Flash the target as soon as you attack it.

reconcileWindowMs.title: Confirmation window (ms)
reconcileWindowMs.description: How long to wait for the server's own hurt event before counting a ghost hit.

hurtCooldownMs.title: Hurt cooldown (ms)
hurtCooldownMs.description: No new prediction for the same target this soon after its last flash.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Diagnostics written to the launcher log.

delays.title: Log late confirmations
delays.description: Log when the server confirms a hit later than the threshold.

delayThresholdMs.title: Late threshold (ms)
delayThresholdMs.description: Confirmations slower than this count as late.

ghosts.title: Log ghost hits
ghosts.description: Log predicted hits the server never confirmed.

hooks.title: Game hooks
hooks.description: Where to find the game functions. Signatures are specific to one Minecraft version; leave them empty and the mod stays idle.

moduleName.title: Game library
moduleName.description: Library the signatures are searched in.

attackSignature.title: Attack function signature
attackSignature.description: Symbol or byte pattern of the function called when the local player attacks an entity.

attackTargetArg.title: Target argument index
attackTargetArg.description: Which argument of the attack function is the target entity (0 = this, 1 = first parameter).

entityEventSignature.title: Entity event handler signature
entityEventSignature.description: Symbol or byte pattern of the function that receives entity events (this, event id, data).

hurtEventId.title: Hurt event id
hurtEventId.description: Event id that plays the hurt animation (2 = HURT_ANIMATION in the Bedrock protocol).
